'''Brian Terwilliger I do all I take all''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Brian Terwilliger]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-4821">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4821 I do all   I take all], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 29 March 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/4821/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/4821/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018191145/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/4821/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
* '''Published:''' 29 March 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''I do all   I take all''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif|label=Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness|Endor-D-combatreadiness.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HDP3MD Terwilliger DS 2000.txt |Download]] (omits dark bith shuffle: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' just fight and have fun.

== Original post ==

'''I do all   I take all'''
* '''Author:''' Brian "twigg" Terwilliger
* '''Published:''' March 29, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' just fight and have fun.

=== Strategy ===

This is fast and strong. All the decks around me this is what i use to kill them. Up here tha play HB, Y4 , and Opps, and plain mains. I can kill all .
